components.name: Lithium-Ion / LiPo Battery Pack
handling_dos: Inspect for swelling, puncturing, or thermal stress before removal
Disconnect battery connector before touching any other internal components
Store in fire-retardant vermiculite lined container at room temperature
Tape over exposed terminal contacts to prevent short-circuiting
handling_donts: DO NOT puncture, bend, pry with sharp metallic tools, or drop
DO NOT attempt cell-level teardown or manual dismantling of battery pouch
DO NOT incinerate or dispose in municipal solid waste
DO NOT expose to temperatures exceeding 60°C or direct moisture

components.name: NVMe / SATA M.2 Solid State Drive
components.recycling_channel: Data Sanitization / Secondary Electronics Marketplace / PCB Refiner
handling_dos: Perform NIST SP 800-88 compliant cryptographic erase or multi-pass wipe
Check S.M.A.R.T health attributes (wear leveling, bad blocks, TBW)
Handle by PCB edges using anti-static ESD wrist strap
Package in conductive anti-static bubble sleeve
handling_donts: DO NOT resell or donate without cryptographically verifying data eradication
DO NOT flex or exert bending pressure on the M.2 PCB
DO NOT touch the gold pin fingers with bare oily fingers

components.name: DDR4 / DDR5 SO-DIMM RAM Module
components.recycling_channel: Secondary Component Testing & Resale / Precious Metal Recovery
handling_dos: Release retaining clips sideways to allow 30-degree popup
Inspect DRAM chips and capacitors for signs of burn or liquid corrosion
Test with MemTest86 on diagnostic bench
Clean contact pins with 99% isopropyl alcohol if oxidized
handling_donts: DO NOT pull module vertically before releasing retaining latches
DO NOT touch gold connector contacts with ungrounded hands
DO NOT subject to electrostatic discharge

components.name: Main Logic Board (CPU/GPU/VRM Subsystem)
components.recycling_channel: High-Grade E-Waste Smelter / Hydrometallurgical Precious Metals Extraction
handling_dos: Unscrew all marked motherboard anchor screws methodically
Disconnect display, trackpad, keyboard, and speaker ZIF cables carefully
Depopulate discrete daughtercards and heat sink before bulk packing
Route to specialized smelter for gold, silver, copper, and palladium reclamation
handling_donts: DO NOT snap or crack the multi-layer PCB when lifting
DO NOT burn or open-air incinerate PCB to melt solder
DO NOT use aggressive acid baths without industrial fume scrubbers

components.name: 15.6-inch LCD / IPS Display Assembly
components.recycling_channel: Panel Testing / Polarizer Refurbishment / Specialized Glass Indium Recovery
handling_dos: Test for backlight bleed, dead pixels, and panel cracked substrate
Disconnect eDP 30/40-pin connector with gentle horizontal pull
Cover glass surface with protective anti-scratch film
Store vertically in padded slot dividers
handling_donts: DO NOT twist, torque, or apply pinpoint pressure on panel face
DO NOT crush CCFL / backlight assemblies (LED is standard, older CCFL has trace mercury)
DO NOT handle broken glass without cut-resistant nitrile gloves

components.name: Copper Heatpipe & Aluminium Fin Assembly
handling_dos: Loosen numbered heatsink screws in diagonal reverse order (4-3-2-1) to avoid chip cracking
Clean dried thermal paste using isopropyl alcohol swabs
Separate copper heat pipes from aluminium fin radiator if automated shredding permits
handling_donts: DO NOT kink or puncture sealed sintered copper vapor heatpipes
DO NOT yank heatsink while thermal paste is cold and bonded

components.name: Brushless Centrifugal DC Blower Fan
components.recycling_channel: Small Appliance Component Reuse / Polymer & Copper Extraction
handling_dos: Check rotor spin freedom and bearing friction noise
Clean accumulated lint and dust using compressed air
Resell as spare replacement part if bearing is smooth
handling_donts: DO NOT over-spin fan blades using excessive pressure air without immobilizing rotor
DO NOT snap plastic impeller blades

components.name: Enclosure & Bottom Chassis (Top/Bottom/Bezel)
components.recycling_channel: Pelletized Polymer Regrind / Post-Consumer Aluminium Recycling
handling_dos: Remove brass threaded standoff inserts using ultrasonic or thermal separation
Separate magnesium-aluminium alloy lids from polycarbonate bottom shells
Shred and pelletize clean thermoplastic casings for injection molding
handling_donts: DO NOT mix flame-retardant polymers with virgin recyclable polymers
DO NOT send metal-inlaid plastics to direct plastic melting furnaces

components.name: Chiclet Keyboard & Precision Capacitive Trackpad
handling_dos: Test key response and actuation matrix on test bench
Inspect scissor-switch mechanisms for missing keycaps
Ultrasonically clean membrane contacts if sticky
handling_donts: DO NOT rip delicate ribbon flat cables
DO NOT submerge trackpad controller electronics in water

components.name: Internal Stereo Speakers with NdFeB Magnets
handling_dos: Extract high-field Neodymium (NdFeB) permanent magnets for rare-earth circularity
Test coil continuity with ohmmeter (4 to 8 ohm typical)
handling_donts: DO NOT store unshielded magnets next to magnetic media or credit cards
DO NOT chip brittle neodymium magnets

components.name: Internal Wiring, Coaxial Antennas & DC-In Jack
handling_dos: Bundle cables together for mechanical granulator wire-stripping
Inspect DC-In power jack for thermal melting or loose center pins
handling_donts: DO NOT open-burn insulated cables to strip PVC/Teflon jackets
